pivHint: REST isn't just what Jesus promises the weary. In sheet music, a symbol showing a pause is called a REST — and the symbols showing which pitch to play are called ______.
winText: You found it. REST isn't just what Jesus promises the weary — in music notation, a REST sits alongside NOTES, the symbols for which pitch to play.
lossText: The word was NOTES. REST was the pivot — in sheet music, a REST marks a pause, while NOTES mark the pitches to play; both are symbols in musical notation.
votdVerse: “Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
passageText: “Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.”
